$$ c = 2 - 3i $$

$$ (z - c) e^{i\pi/4} = (\sqrt{2} - 3\sqrt{2}i) \left( \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}i \right) $$

$$ = (1 - 3i)(1 + i) $$
$$ = 1 + i - 3i - 3i^2 $$
$$ = 1 - 2i + 3 $$
$$ = 4 - 2i $$

Finally, add $c$ back to find $w$:
$$ w = c + (4 - 2i) $$
$$ w = (2 - 3i) + (4 - 2i) $$
